data.narrative:
Crusoe Energy is a Series C artificial intelligence and software company founded by Chase Lochmiller and Cully Cavness. The target carries a current post-money valuation of $10.0B+ and has raised $3B+ to date. The peer universe consists of nine comparable companies across AI & Software: one public entity (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and eight private firms including Figure AI, Skild AI, and Together AI, all at Series C stage.

Two valuation methods apply here. Stage-progression analysis uses the $10.0B last post-money valuation as a base and applies a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C to successor-stage advancement, implying $17.0B. Peer-median methodology examines three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Figure AI at $39.0B, Skild AI at $14.0B, and Together AI at $8.3B. The median of this set is $14.0B, with a range of $8.3B to $39.0B, reflecting material heterogeneity in the cohort.

Triangulating these two methods across a conservative-to-optimistic spectrum yields a valuation range of $11.9B to $19.6B, with a median point of $15.5B. This range brackets the current $10.0B+ valuation. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion among peer valuations (4.7x spread) and the stage-progression multiplier's sensitivity to market conditions. The analysis does not account for revenue scale, profitability, or defensibility differences that may justify positioning within this range.
